title: AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.05556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge's bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate them hold a few hundred items or fewer. In this regime the per-item mean weights weak judges as heavily as strong ones, and confusion-table models such as Dawid-Skene must estimate a per-judge error table from too few items. We propose AGORA (Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments), an item-response-theory aggregator that places every item on one latent quality scale and describes each judge by a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, so judge reliability is learned from all items jointly and without human labels. Across three benchmarks, AGORA matches or exceeds Dawid-Skene on large evaluation sets, and its advantage widens as the set shrinks toward a few hundred items. I

translated_title: AGORA：基于项目反应理论的可靠性感知LLM裁判聚合方法
translated_abstract: LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）是替代昂贵人工评估的常用方式，而聚合多个裁判的评估结果是应对单一裁判偏差的标准方法。然而，裁判池中混杂着可靠性差异极大的裁判，而用于验证裁判的人工标注数据集通常只有几百个样本甚至更少。在这种情形下，逐项平均的方法对弱裁判和强裁判赋予同等权重，而像Dawid-Skene这样的混淆表模型则必须从过少的样本中估计每个裁判的错误表。我们提出AGORA（可靠性加权评估聚合器），这是一个基于项目反应理论的聚合方法，它将每个评估项置于同一潜在质量量表上，并用敏感度参数和有序评分阈值来刻画每个裁判，从而能够从所有评估项中联合学习裁判的可靠性，且无需人工标注。在三个基准测试中，AGORA在大型评估集上达到或超过Dawid-Skene的表现，且随着评估集缩小至几百个样本，其优势进一步扩大。
tldr: 提出基于项目反应理论的AGORA聚合器，通过敏感度参数和有序评分阈值刻画各LLM裁判，无需人工标注即可从全部评估项中联合学习裁判可靠性，在仅有几百个样本的小规模评估集上显著优于Dawid-Skene等传统方法。
en_tdlr: AGORA is an item-response-theory-based aggregator that models each LLM judge with a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, learning judge reliability jointly from all items without human labels, and its advantage over Dawid-Skene widens as evaluation sets shrink to a few hundred items.
